name: What information should my med spa website include for effective AEO?

mainEntity.name: What information should my med spa website include for effective AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: For effective AEO, your med spa website should include comprehensive and clear information on each service offered, detailing benefits, what to expect during treatment, and post-procedure care. Dedicated FAQ pages addressing common patient concerns are vital. Include well-researched blog posts that answer specific, long-tail questions related to treatments and conditions. Ensure your 'About Us' and 'Contact' pages are also optimized with location-specific keywords for local searches, providing all necessary details for potential clients.
acceptedAnswer.description: Effective AEO requires comprehensive service details, dedicated FAQ pages, informative blog posts answering specific questions, and optimized local business information on your med spa website.
